# Juniper Lantern classes and trials

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

Moss Steps meets Monday at 16:20 and is for ages 6 to 8. Lantern Jazz meets Tuesday at 17:15 and is for ages 9 to 12. Reed Ballet meets Wednesday at 16:40 and is for ages 8 to 11. Cloud Contemporary meets Thursday at 18:00 and is for ages 12 to 16. Pebble Creative meets Saturday at 09:30 and is for ages 4 to 5. These listings are schedules, not availability or bookings.

A single trial costs $24. The office arranges trials after checking a live place. The trial fee is credited against first-term tuition only when enrolment is completed within 7 calendar days of the trial. Trial attendance does not reserve a term place. Beginners can join Moss Steps and Reed Ballet; Cloud Contemporary requires a teacher discussion before a beginner trial.
